about: RFC 0020 host rule: whether a DSH is Unfold's own instance, from AUTOMAGIK_HOST and AUTOMAGIK_PRELOAD. Either one names it when its value, trimmed and lowercased, is unfold; anything else, or nothing, does not. Read by apps/bots-dsh/test/unfold-host.test.js (inUnfoldInstance and the Unfold Bot stand-in's unfoldLeads) and apps/welcome-dsh/test/unfold.test.js (hostOf); each must answer every case. Unfold's own repository may test unfold-bot-dsh's unfoldLeads against this file at a pinned commit. A change to the rule is a pull request here first, and a breaking change for Unfold.
